headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Negatives: • Under-recoveries due to the Max Smart expansion impacted margins by ~150 bps. • Several of Max’s new projects have faced delays since the initial announcement. • Despite the correction, the stock is still trading at a punchy ~28X FY28E pre-Ind AS-116 EV/EBITDA after baking in the hit from the trade margin caps on onco drugs.
